info.name: Hugo Preview
info.summary: Build and preview Hugo static sites from Nextcloud folders
info.description:
Hugo Preview builds Hugo static sites from folders in Nextcloud Files and displays the generated site without leaving Nextcloud.
Features: - Select one or more Hugo project folders from Nextcloud Files - Build and preview sites through the Nextcloud interface - Live rebuilds while editing Markdown in Nextcloud Text - Attachment, callout, task-list, and relative-link handling - Independent per-user project configuration
Requirements: - The Hugo executable must be installed and available to the Nextcloud PHP process
info.author: Schuyler "Rocky" Reidel, Reidel Law Firm
